base.description: The target branch the PR merges into (the protected main line). The seat never merges it — a human governor does, on green CI.

branch.description: The fresh non-main branch the engine commits to and pushes: changeset/<originating-gig-uuid> for a change gig. Never main/master, never the base.

commit_sha.description: ENGINE-STAMPED: the HEAD commit the engine pushed to the branch, read from git after the push — never written by a seat.

pr_url.description: ENGINE-STAMPED: the opened pull request URL, read from the API's answer — never written by a seat.

pr_number.description: ENGINE-STAMPED: the opened pull request number, from the same answer.

title.description: The PR title, stating what changed.

body.description: The PR body the seat composed: the rationale and the verifier's verdict verbatim, and any dead-end or unnamed-change the seat must state. The engine sends it to the API as given.

commit_message.description: The commit message the engine commits the named paths under. The engine appends its trailers (Coltrane-Gig, Coltrane-Acting-For, Coltrane-Lease, Coltrane-Engine, Coltrane-Intent-Sha).

paths.description: The files the engine commits, by path relative to the tree: the UNION of the change-set's paths and the red-spec's paths when one was sealed. Nothing else is staged — never a blanket add.

intent_sha.description: ENGINE-STAMPED: sha256 of the canonical intent (base, branch, body, commit_message, paths, title) the seat sealed; also carried as the commit's Coltrane-Intent-Sha trailer, so the commit traces to the intent that authorized it.
